## 📋 Pre-Submission Checklist
<!-- Please verify each of the following before submitting. -->
- [ ] **Target Branch**: This PR targets the `development` branch (NOT `main`).
- [ ] **Formatting**: Ran `pnpm format` and confirmed with `pnpm format:check`.
- [ ] **Linting**: Ran `pnpm lint` and resolved all errors/warnings.
- [ ] **Type Checking**: Ran `pnpm typecheck` successfully.
- [ ] **Verification**: Ran `pnpm verify` and confirmed the build passes locally.
- [ ] **Commit Messages**: Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat(api): ...`).
- [ ] **Clean Git History**: No merge commits, unneeded files, or secrets (`.env`) included.
